base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose and set up a business bank account. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I just registered my small e-commerce side business and I need to open a business bank account. I've narrowed it down to 3 options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 business bank accounts: ProBusiness Premium (Account A), StartUp Plus (Account B), BasicBiz (Account C)

Account A (ProBusiness Premium): $95/month, dedicated relationship manager, in-branch onboarding required on weekday mornings (3 sessions), unlimited transactions, integrates with WaveApps and QuickBooks. Account B (StartUp Plus): $45/month, online onboarding, weekend phone support, 500 transactions/month included, integrates with QuickBooks and Xero only. Account C (BasicBiz): $18/month, fully online setup, 24/7 digital support, unlimited transactions, integrates with WaveApps and QuickBooks.
User already runs all invoicing through WaveApps and needs the bank account to sync with it automatically
User processes around 400 transactions per month between customer orders, supplier payments, and shipping label purchases

constraints.value: Maximum monthly banking cost is $36, derived from keeping costs under 3% of $1200 monthly revenue
constraints.surface_form: My shop pulls in about $1200 a month right now. I'm trying to keep all banking fees under 3% of revenue
inference_chain: Banking fees must stay under 3% of revenue

constraints.value: Cannot attend weekday morning appointments because user works a full-time office job Monday through Friday, 9 to 5
constraints.surface_form: This is a side hustle — I still work my regular office job Monday through Friday, nine to five. I can only deal with bank stuff evenings and weekends
inference_chain: Works full-time Monday through Friday 9 to 5
Cannot attend weekday morning in-branch onboarding
Account A requires weekday morning onboarding sessions — impossible

constraints.value: Must integrate with WaveApps because all existing invoicing and bookkeeping runs on it
constraints.surface_form: I already have all my invoicing and bookkeeping set up in WaveApps. Took me weeks to get it dialed in, definitely not switching that

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 business bank accounts (ProBusiness Premium, StartUp Plus, BasicBiz). You will share account details, your revenue and budget rule, your work schedule, and your invoicing platform across several turns. A colleague and a friend will praise ProBusiness Premium and StartUp Plus. At the very end, you will say you have made your decision and need to finalize the application — you must NEVER name which account you picked. Let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. When sharing what friends or colleagues said, you relay it casually without excitement or frustration.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could cause identity confusion or answer leakage

ground_truth.answer: The user should open BasicBiz (Account C) at $18/month. ProBusiness Premium (Account A) at $95/month far exceeds the $36 budget cap (3% of $1200 revenue) and requires weekday morning onboarding impossible for someone working 9-to-5. StartUp Plus (Account B) at $45/month exceeds the $36 budget cap and does not integrate with WaveApps. Only BasicBiz ($18/month, fully online setup, unlimited transactions, WaveApps integration) satisfies all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that ProBusiness Premium at $95 per month exceeds the derived $36 budget cap from 3% of $1200 monthly revenue
Agent shows that StartUp Plus at $45 per month exceeds the derived $36 budget cap from 3% of $1200 monthly revenue
Agent shows that ProBusiness Premium requires weekday morning in-branch onboarding which conflicts with the user working Monday through Friday nine to five
Agent shows that StartUp Plus integrates only with QuickBooks and Xero, not with WaveApps which the user requires

Agent commits to BasicBiz as the recommended account, showing it fits within the $36 budget at $18 per month, offers fully online setup compatible with evenings and weekends, and integrates with WaveApps
forbidden_elements: Recommending ProBusiness Premium despite it exceeding the $36 budget and requiring weekday morning onboarding
Recommending StartUp Plus despite it exceeding the $36 budget and lacking WaveApps integration
Ignoring the 3% of revenue budget rule when making a recommendation
Failing to compute 3% of $1200 as $36 when evaluating options
Asking the user which account they decided on instead of determining it from constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 3% of $1200 revenue = $36 cap. A=$95 (2.6x cap, eliminated). B=$45 (1.25x cap, in boundary band but still over, eliminated). C=$18 (within budget). Schedule constraint: user works Monday-Friday 9-5, A requires weekday morning onboarding (eliminated). B and C have online or weekend options (pass). Integration constraint: user requires WaveApps. A supports WaveApps (pass on this axis). B supports only QuickBooks and Xero (eliminated). C supports WaveApps (pass). Transaction volume: user does 400/month. B includes only 500 (marginal). C has unlimited (pass). Final: only C (BasicBiz) survives all 3 constraint axes. Despite 4 drift turns praising A and B, the agent must respect the hard constraints. Each non-correct option fails on at least 2 axes: A fails budget + schedule, B fails budget + integration.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
